description: Implement DesktopChannel (BaseChannel subclass) in CoPaw core to expose WebSocket endpoint
test_case: Use wscat or Python websocket client to connect to ws://127.0.0.1:8088/desktop/ws and exchange messages
steps: 1. Create DesktopChannel class inheriting from BaseChannel in copaw/app/channels/desktop/
2. Implement build_agent_request_from_native to convert WebSocket JSON to AgentRequest
3. Implement async start() to register WebSocket route on FastAPI app
4. Implement async send() to push messages back to WebSocket client
5. Register channel in ChannelManager config
6. Write integration test: connect, send text, receive echo

description: Implement WebSocket client with auto-reconnect and message queue
test_case: pytest apps/copaw_desktop/tests/test_network.py - test connect, disconnect, reconnect, send/receive
steps: 1. Create WebSocketClient class in core/network.py
2. Implement connect() with exponential backoff retry
3. Implement message queue (asyncio.Queue) for outgoing messages
4. Implement listener loop for incoming messages
5. Add connection state tracking and callbacks
6. Write unit tests with mock WebSocket server

description: Implement SQLite session storage with SQLAlchemy ORM
test_case: pytest apps/copaw_desktop/tests/test_database.py - test CRUD operations and hourly grouping query
steps: 1. Define Session and Message models in core/models.py
2. Create SessionDB class with SQLAlchemy engine
3. Implement create_session(), get_sessions_grouped_by_hour()
4. Implement add_message(), get_messages(session_id)
5. Write comprehensive unit tests with in-memory SQLite
6. Verify hourly grouping logic with test data

description: Integrate cloud ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) client
test_case: pytest tests/test_asr.py - use sample.wav, assert correct text transcription
steps: 1. Create ASRClient abstract base class in core/asr.py
2. Implement AlibabaCloudASRClient (or OpenAI/Google variant)
3. Add audio format conversion (PCM to required format)
4. Implement transcribe(audio_bytes) -> str method
5. Add error handling and retry logic
6. Write tests with recorded sample audio files

test_case: pytest tests/test_tts.py - synthesize text, verify audio file is valid
steps: 1. Create TTSClient abstract base class in core/tts.py
2. Implement EdgeTTSClient (free, high quality)
3. Implement synthesize(text) -> bytes method
4. Add voice selection and speed control parameters
5. Implement audio playback using pygame or pydub
6. Write tests to verify audio output format and duration

description: Initialize PyQt6 main window with fullscreen and 3-column layout
test_case: Run main.py, verify window is fullscreen with visible left(20%), middle(40%), right(40%) panels
steps: 1. Create MainWindow class inheriting QMainWindow
2. Implement setup_ui() with QHBoxLayout splitter
3. Create placeholder widgets for Left/Middle/Right panels
4. Set window flags for fullscreen (showFullScreen())
5. Add stylesheet for panel borders and colors
6. Test on both Ubuntu and Windows

description: Implement left panel SessionListWidget with hourly grouping
test_case: Inject mock session data, verify tree structure shows date -> hour -> session correctly
steps: 1. Create SessionListWidget inheriting QWidget with QTreeWidget
2. Implement data binding to SessionDB
3. Create hierarchical items: Date -> Hour -> Session
4. Implement click handler to emit session_selected signal
5. Add refresh mechanism when new session created
6. Write GUI test with QTest framework

description: Implement middle panel ChatPanelWidget with message bubbles
test_case: Send test messages, verify bubbles appear with correct styling
steps: 1. Create ChatPanelWidget with QScrollArea and QVBoxLayout
2. Create MessageBubble widget (user/assistant styles)
3. Implement add_message(role, content) method
4. Implement streaming text append (typing effect)
5. Add auto-scroll to bottom on new message

description: Implement right panel DynamicPanel for image and markdown preview
test_case: Display test image and markdown content
steps: 1. Create DynamicPanel with QStackedWidget
2. Create ImagePreviewWidget using QLabel + QPixmap
3. Create MarkdownPreviewWidget (simplified with QLabel)
4. Implement show_image() and show_markdown() methods

description: Implement right panel ChartWidget with ECharts integration
test_case: Send ECharts option JSON, verify interactive chart renders
steps: 1. Create ChartWidget inheriting QWidget
2. Embed ECharts library via CDN or local bundle
3. Implement render_chart(option_json) method

description: Implement AudioRecorder with VAD (Voice Activity Detection)
test_case: Speak into microphone, verify VAD cuts audio into sentences on 1.5s silence
steps: 1. Create AudioRecorder using PyAudio in separate thread
2. Integrate webrtcvad for speech detection
3. Implement circular buffer for audio frames
4. Detect speech start -> begin recording
5. Detect 1.5s silence -> emit speech segment via callback
6. Add manual stop and start controls

description: Implement AudioRecorder with VAD (Voice Activity Detection)
test_case: Manual test: speak into microphone, verify VAD splits audio on silence
steps: 1. Create AudioRecorder using PyAudio in separate thread
2. Integrate webrtcvad for speech detection
3. Implement circular buffer for audio frames
4. Detect speech start and silence duration (1.5s)
5. Emit speech segments via callback
6. Add manual stop and mute controls

description: Assemble full pipeline: Audio -> ASR -> WebSocket -> UI -> TTS with state management
test_case: End-to-end test: speak into mic, verify chat bubble appears, TTS plays response
steps: 1. Create Application orchestrator class
2. Connect AudioRecorder.audio_chunk -> ASRClient.transcribe
3. Connect ASR result -> WebSocketClient.send
4. Connect WebSocketClient.message -> ChatPanelWidget + DynamicPanel
5. Connect CoPaw text response -> TTSClient.synthesize -> playback
6. Implement TTS playback mute on AudioRecorder (echo cancellation)
7. Add state machine for IDLE/LISTENING/PROCESSING/SPEAKING
8. Write integration test script
